options: Keep June on normal sales monitoring

O.content: The title reads “Monthly Sales for Store B in City Y.”
Three blue bars are positioned above the labels April, May, and June.
The top edge of the blue bar above “June” is horizontally aligned with the black dashed line.
The word “Average” is printed next to the dashed horizontal line.

B.text: If the bar heights encode monthly sales for the labeled months, the dashed line labeled “Average” is the relevant sales baseline, and the routing convention treats a June result at that baseline as normal monitoring, then June maps to the normal-sales route.
B.conditions: The chart title and axis labels apply to Store B monthly sales; exact alignment is treated as at-baseline. The normal-monitoring mapping is an unstated operational convention, not a supplied policy.
